subject: Ciências
description_pt: Justificar a importância das unidades de conservação para a preservação da biodiversidade e do patrimônio nacional, considerando os diferentes tipos de unidades (parques, reservas e florestas nacionais), as populações humanas e as atividades a eles relacionados.

components.description_pt: Identificar os diferentes tipos de unidades de conservação e suas características definidoras
components.description_en: Identify the different types of conservation units and their defining characteristics

components.description_pt: Explicar a importância das unidades de conservação para preservar biodiversidade e patrimônio natural
components.description_en: Explain the importance of conservation units for preserving biodiversity and natural heritage
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate strategies for sustaining biodiversity to maintain ecosystem services for human benefit

components.description_pt: Descrever as populações humanas associadas a unidades de conservação e as atividades permitidas dentro delas
components.description_en: Describe the human populations associated with conservation units and the activities permitted within them

components.description_pt: Justificar o papel das unidades de conservação na proteção do patrimônio natural nacional
components.description_en: Justify the role of conservation units in protecting national natural heritage

cc_matches.description: Humans depend on the living world for the resources and other benefits provided by biodiversity. But human activity is also having adverse impacts on biodiversity through overpopulation, overexploitation, habitat destruction, pollution, introduction of invasive species, and climate change. Thus sustaining biodiversity so that ecosystem functioning and productivity are maintained is essential to supporting and enhancing life on Earth. Sustaining biodiversity also aids humanity by preserving landscapes of recreational or inspirational value.
